theBlocker.proofByExperiment: In this container: load the pinned Statement binary with pdf-lib, setText('04') on 'Month / Mes', updateFieldAppearances, flatten, save. pdftotext -f 12 -l 12 -layout on the result prints '04' immediately under 'Juramentado y suscrito ante mí el día de hoy del mes de' and above '____________________________, 20____'. Writing the participant's birth month therefore stamps that month into the NOTARY's section of source page 12 (packet page 21). The probe file was written to /tmp and deleted.
theBlocker.whyTheFinalizerCannotAvoidIt: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs holds one value per FIELD, not per widget, and says so in its own comment at the fitting step: 'a field holds one value however many places it is printed.' Its three widget-aware options are all about SIZE, not value -- fitTextPerWidget measures each widget's rectangle, applyPerWidgetDefaultAppearanceSizes writes each widget's own /DA size, alignWidgetDefaultAppearanceSizes writes one size to all of them. There is no per-widget value, no widget-index selector on explicitMappings, and no pre-fill hook a caller could use to suppress one widget's appearance. printedDateOrderByField reorders a whole ISO date for printing; it does not split one into parts.
theBlocker.consequenceForTheAssignment: The assignment requires, in the same sentence, that the three cells be written and that 'the notary's Year on source page 12 must stay refused; nothing else on either page moves'. With the shared finalizer as it stands those two requirements are in direct contradiction for the Month cell. Writing it moves the notary's month blank on page 12 and is a protected write into a jurat -- the worst class of defect this family's own PROTECTED_FIELDS reading is built to prevent.

theSecondFactualErrorInTheAssignment.assignmentStated: 'written from the held date of birth exactly as the same date is already split on source page 2 (the build already splits it there, so decline nothing)'
theSecondFactualErrorInTheAssignment.whatIsActuallyThere: The build does NOT split the date on source page 2. 'My date of birth / Mi fecha de nacimiento es' on source page 2 is a single text field, one widget, rect x 114.57 y 569.24 w 419.081 h 20.949, and the build writes the whole ISO string into it -- '1994-04-17' canonical, '1972-12-31' boundary, as reports/actual-writes.json records at packet page 11. There is no existing split to copy, so the instruction 'decline nothing' rests on a split that does not exist. A split would have to be introduced here for the first time, as three new date-part facts, which is a larger change than the assignment describes and does not by itself clear the two-widget blocker.

rows.whyTheStatedFallbackIsAlsoUnavailable: The repair note quoted in the assignment offers, as its second branch, declaring the three cells REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with a named reason and disclosing them in participant-instructions.md. scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/completeness-contract.mjs forecloses that branch on this family. REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING_CONDITIONS condition 3, GENUINELY UNAVAILABLE, reads: 'the platform holds no value for the fact. A fact written anywhere else in the same packet is available, and refusing it here is a missing known fact.' The platform holds this participant's date of birth and the packet writes it on packet page 11. classifyBlank enforces the same thing at line 452: a row declaring requiredBeforeFiling with factAvailable true returns KNOWN_FACT_NOT_WRITTEN, which carries knownRequiredFieldsMissing. The gate is reachable only by declaring factAvailable false, which on this packet would be a false declaration made to clear a counter. This lane will not make one.
whatARealRepairWouldRequire: A per-widget value facility in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs -- an opt-in, default-off option in the established pattern of fitTextPerWidget, alignWidgetFontSizeToFit and detachNestedControlFields -- that writes a field's value into named widget indices only and leaves the other widgets' appearance streams empty through flatten, with the write recorded per widget so reports/actual-writes.json can still read it back from the flattened appearances.

Three date-part facts in the builder's own fact map, or a date-part selector on explicitMappings, so the held ISO date of birth can be addressed as month, day and year without binding a whole date to a bare date-component field name -- which scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs currently refuses, and which scripts/rcap-official-forms/verify-name-date-component-semantics.mjs holds in place across every committed census.

Splitting the 'declaration_date' rule in SOI_RULES so the three date-of-birth cells carry the caption the form prints ('My date of birth is / Mi fecha de nacimiento es') while 'Today' and the notary's 'Year' keep the signing-date refusal they correctly have.

A corpus-wide byte-identity control: the finalizer is read by roughly 250 families, so every other family must be rebuilt against a throwaway control and shown byte-identical before any of it is committed.

A re-reading of the field map's own blindness to the second widget: the map records ONE row for 'Month / Mes' at page 11 taking widgets[0] only, so the notary's month blank on source page 12 is enumerated nowhere in production-field-map.json. Whoever takes the shared-finalizer change should score that separately.
